item.title: Even in Your Groaning, Remember That the Lord Will Restore All Things
item.description: The Bible is punctuated with promises of restoration. They assure you that restoration is written into God’s unshakable redemptive plan.

item.title: What Is the Sabbath?
item.description: In a lifetime of “anxious toil,” we need a regular reset. Day after day, the tasks just keep coming, and while the Bible affirms the goodness of work, it also acknowledges its frustrations.

item.title: How (and How Not) to Fast
item.description: At times, the Bible is heavy on warnings. That’s the case for the topic of fasting. It can be frustrating to those of us who want a straightforward instruction manual for this spiritual discipline.

item.title: Podcast: A Beginner’s Guide to Fasting (Cassie Achermann)
item.description: Cassie Achermann discusses what fasting is, how the Bible talks about it, and how you can begin to practice it.

item.title: 4 Practical Tools to Help You Pray
item.description: The Lord’s personal habits in prayer also provided a model for the disciples—and for us. Jesus’s example shows us that prayer doesn’t happen accidentally. We must be purposeful in prayer.

item.title: How We Can Pursue Joy in the Midst of Suffering
item.description: The question about suffering and the pursuit of joy in suffering is relentless because suffering is relentless. And the Bible is just so helpful because it’s so realistic.

item.title: Sabbath Is More Than Self-Care
item.description: No longer dismissed as the niche habit of observant Jews and New England Puritans, the Sabbath is now a habit that seemingly everyone aspires to.

item.title: Introducing a Kids’ Book from Matt Boswell About Holy Week
item.description: Ten beautiful poems by hymn writer Matthew Boswell walk children through well-known and less familiar days of Holy Week.

item.title: Crossway+ Special: Up to 50% Off Select Commentaries
item.description: An exclusive offer for Crossway+ members on resources from the ESV Expository Commentary, The Psalms: A Christ-Centered Commentary, the Preaching the Word commentary series, and The Collected Works of John Piper.

item.title: Discipling Is Inherently Countercultural
item.description: In our contemporary world, where efficiency, appearance, and marketability are high values, spending hours with disciplees seems like a waste of a leader’s time.
